conventions.frame: absolute frame index of the reference, decoded from the start (0-based); verified by exact-frame alignment against a full decode
conventions.offsets: recipe frame offsets are relative to the element's first changed frame (offset 0)
conventions.zoom: zoom = output-frame magnification relative to the screencast's own unzoomed (full-bleed) frame; view rect = source-frame region shown, [x0,y0,x1,y1] in source 1080p px
conventions.easing: cubic-bezier applied to log(zoom) progress: zoom(t)=z0*(z1/z0)^bez((t-t0)/D); the view rect moves so its corners progress linearly with view WIDTH (constant fixed point = rect lerp). Measured deviation of corners from width progress 0.000-0.006 on clean events

facecam.shape: circle, screen-space overlay (never zoomed/panned with the screencast)

ring.fill: linear gradient left->right across the ring (angle 90deg, horizontal), colour(u)=c0+c1*u with u=(x-cx)/r in [-1,1]; NO vertical component

shadow.type: soft dark outer shadow, no offset, no coloured glow

presenter_feed.source: same camera/set as the A-roll (brick wall, Shure SM7B) - a different moment of the same recording
presenter_feed.crop: square ~715x715 px of the A-roll wide framing centred on the face (x~582-1298, y~32-748), scaled to the 344 px inner disc; eyes ~29 px above disc centre, mic top visible at the bottom edge
presenter_feed.confidence: medium (eye-distance measurement, not a fitted warp)

facecam.consistency: identical geometry in every screencast span (ring-pixel fraction 0.58+-0.02 in all 25 spans, colour fit identical on f839/f2200/f3100)
facecam.visibility_rule: shown on EVERY screencast frame, never on A-roll/full-screen talking head; enters and exits by hard cut on the same frame as the A-roll<->screencast cut (21 cut-ins + 21 cut-outs, 0 frames). Hidden (faded) only while the zoom/action target is inside the bubble's top-right zone: 5577-5770 (Artlist sign-in / top-right header) and 7345-7401 (zoom onto 'Get More Credits/Upgrade to Max' top-right).
facecam.gemini_claims_rejected: 00:36-00:46 and 05:06-05:58 'hidden' are wrong: bubble present on every frame of 1080-1380 and 9166-10500

hide_zone_px.note: bubble disc + ~40 px margin; inferred from 2 events

out.note: offset 0 = first frame below 1 (f5572; f7337). Fades out together with a screen crossfade/zoom

fade.scale_change: none - opacity only (ring radius/centre constant while fading)

recipe.model: virtual camera over the full-bleed screen recording; states: FULL (1.0) and FOCUS(target). Every move is one cubic-bezier on log-zoom with the view rect lerped (fixed point).

entry_push_in.rule: every screencast span that starts unzoomed gets an automatic push-in starting on its 1st-2nd frame (t0 = cut + 0.9..2.3 f; 9 of 15 spans start this way)

recipe.target_placement: centre the view on the target, then clamp the view rect inside the source frame (10 of 17 clean zoom-ins end touching a frame edge: bottom edge for bottom prompt bars, left edge for left content); unclamped views put the target within ~6% of centre (f815 dropdown at 0.56/0.50, f7536 prompt bar at 0.50/0.44, f12619 exact centre)
recipe.hold: view is pixel-static while held (zoom constant +-0.001, no drift, no cursor-follow): e.g. f866-f988 constant 1.412 while the cursor opens the dropdown
recipe.retarget_while_zoomed: a second zoom/pan move from the zoomed state to a new target, same curve (f4617: 1.35->1.53 with pan; f4162)
recipe.exit: zoomed state usually ends with the cut to A-roll (hard cut) or a jump-cut; explicit zoom-out back to 1.0 seen 6x (bezier above), e.g. after a 2.03x punch the hold was 32 f before zooming out
recipe.cadence: ~1 camera move per 13-17 s of screencast (about 36 measured moves in ~514 s of screencast) - NOT every 5-8 s; zoom-in at almost every span start, holds of 1-30 s, inner hard jump-cuts carry the zoom state across
recipe.page_change_transition: screen-to-screen inside a span: hard cut (most) or a short crossfade 6-10 f (f7205-7211, f999-1009) during which the outgoing zooms out / incoming continues its own zoom
recipe.screencast_frame: full-bleed 1920x1080, no inset/margins/rounded corners/background; recording is already UI-magnified (browser at large scale, no OS taskbar)

scroll.edited_scroll_moves: none found - no synthetic smooth scroll/pan of the screen in the edit apart from zoom re-targets
scroll.note: native mouse-wheel scrolls (~200 px per flick over 9-16 f, browser smooth-scroll). Gemini's 'slow scroll down' at 09:04 / 09:19-10:00 not confirmed (those spans are static between jump cuts).

cursor.type: native OS cursor captured in the recording (white arrow / Windows hand on links), scales with the zoom (it is part of the frame)
cursor.smoothing: none detectable (natural hand motion, small idle drift, eases into targets)
cursor.click_indication: none (no ring/ripple/highlight); only the native pointer->hand change
cursor.typing: prompt text appears at once between consecutive sampled frames (f7602->f7608) = paste or jump-cut, no visible char-by-char typing in the measured instance

unmeasured: zoom target coordinates were inferred from end views + vision, not from logged click events
D vs zoom-ratio relation is weak (r~0.6)
bubble shadow on dark backgrounds is unmeasurable
presenter crop inside bubble measured by eye distance only
